item.title: Version 2.1.1
item.description:
Fixes from testing with real ATEM switchers (2 M/E Constellation HD, SDI Pro ISO) with Companion, AtemStatus, MiddleControl and ATEM Software Control.

- MiddleControl now syncs through the proxy (the handshake reply carries the real session id).
- Clients that disconnect are acknowledged and dropped right away.
- New clients get the complete state from Constellation switchers.
- Lower idle CPU use (2.5% to 1.1%) and lower forwarding latency.
- More robust packet resending.
